cau_hoi: What characteristic does the electron shell structure of an atom have?
A: Electrons move in defined orbits in space.
B: Electrons exist only at fixed energy levels.
C: Electrons can exist in multiple positions at the same time.
D: Electrons do not interact with the atomic nucleus.
giai_thich: Option C is correct because, according to quantum mechanics, electrons do not have defined orbits but exist in orbitals with certain probabilities. This can be visualized as a 'cloud' around the nucleus. An interesting application is that this principle helps explain the chemical properties of elements, influencing how they interact in chemical reactions.
